parameters.name: datasources
parameters.description: Restrict metadata to one or more datasource identifiers as returned by this endpoint (for example, `jira`). With a nonblank `query`, exactly one datasource is required. Unknown or inaccessible identifiers return `invalid_datasource`.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Optional search query that requests suggested filter values for the selected datasource. Must be nonblank when present. Triggers a search for facet values only; does not return documents.
